# Doc Guardian - Documentation Automation Skill

## What I Do

1. **Code Documentation** - Automatically generates JSDoc/TSDoc comments for functions, classes, and modules
2. **Changelog Generation** - Creates/updates CHANGELOG.md with all changes made during the task
3. **Language Support** - Configurable documentation language (English, German, Spanish, French, etc.)

## When to Use Me

- At the end of every task for automatic documentation
- When code needs inline documentation
- When keeping a changelog is required
- Before committing code to main branch

## Instructions

### 1. Run Documentation Generator

```bash
# Generate documentation for all files
npx doc-guardian generate

# Generate for specific files
npx doc-guardian generate --files src/*.ts

# Preview changes without applying
npx doc-guardian generate --dry-run
```

### 2. Generate Changelog

```bash
# Generate changelog from git changes
npx doc-guardian changelog

# Generate with specific format
npx doc-guardian changelog --format markdown

# Include all commits (not just since last tag)
npx doc-guardian changelog --all
```

### 3. Both at Once

```bash
# Generate docs and changelog
npx doc-guardian all
```

## Configuration

Create `.doc-guardian.json` in your project root:

```json
{
  "language": "en",
  "changelog": {
    "includeAuthor": true,
    "commitTypes": ["feat", "fix", "docs", "refactor", "perf", "test"],
    "outputFile": "CHANGELOG.md"
  },
  "documentation": {
    "includeExamples": true,
    "includeDeprecated": true,
    "minifyDescriptions": false
  },
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "*.test.ts", "*.spec.ts"]
}
```

### Configuration Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `language` | string | "en" | Documentation language (en, de, es, fr, etc.) |
| `changelog.includeAuthor` | boolean | true | Include commit author in changelog |
| `changelog.commitTypes` | array | all types | Which commit types to include |
| `changelog.outputFile` | string | "CHANGELOG.md" | Output filename |
| `documentation.includeExamples` | boolean | true | Include code examples in docs |
| `documentation.includeDeprecated` | boolean | true | Mark deprecated functions |
| `exclude` | array | [] | Files/directories to exclude |

## Changelog Format

```markdown
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-15

### Features
- Add new user authentication (John Doe)
- Implement password reset functionality

### Bug Fixes
- Fix memory leak in data processor

### Documentation
- Update API documentation

[Unreleased]: https://github.com/user/repo/compare/v1.0.0...HEAD
```

## Git Integration

The changelog is NOT added to .gitignore by default. To exclude it manually:

```bash
# Only if you want to exclude (not recommended)
echo "CHANGELOG.md" >> .gitignore
```

## Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning | Action |
|------|---------|--------|
| 0 | Success | Documentation generated |
| 1 | No changes | Nothing to document |
| 2 | Config error | Check configuration |
| 3 | Git error | Check git repository |

## Tips

- Configure language in `.doc-guardian.json` before first run
- Run `doc-guardian all` before every commit
- Review generated comments for accuracy
- Add the skill to your pre-commit hook

# Doc Guardian - OhMyOpenCode Skill

Automatically generates code documentation (JSDoc, TSDoc comments) and creates a CHANGELOG.md file with all changes made during the task. Supports configurable documentation language.

## Features

- **Code Documentation** - Automatically generates JSDoc/TSDoc comments
- **Changelog Generation** - Creates/updates CHANGELOG.md with task changes
- **Multi-language Support** - Configurable documentation language

